body:
`src/app/api/search/route.ts` inserts a `search_logs` row on **every debounced keystroke of 2+ characters**, recording `query_text`, `user_id` and `results_count`.

The read side is fully built and mounted nowhere:
- `src/actions/analytics/get-search-analytics.ts` — `getSearchAnalytics`
- `src/hooks/use-search-analytics.ts` — `useSearchAnalytics`
- `src/components/analytics/search-analytics-card.tsx` — `SearchAnalyticsCard`

An uncapped grep of `src/**` finds zero usages of the hook or the component outside their own definitions. `src/app/(dashboard)/analytics/analytics-page-client.tsx` does not reference them.

So the app records what every admin types into search, indefinitely, with no consumer. Either surface the analytics card or stop writing the rows — collecting user query text with no reader is hard to justify.

Note `src/actions/system/prune-data.ts` already prunes this table and its own comment is unsure whether it exists.

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

title: search_logs is written on every keystroke but nothing reads it
